text:
James Tibbs’ team, the Oklahoma City Comets, lose 7-3 to Sacramento River Cats in MiLB game on July 21
By
P. M. GatlinOn Tuesday, July 21, at 9:45 p.m., former Pope High School standout James Tibbs’ current team, the Oklahoma City Comets, fell 7-3 to the Sacramento River Cats in a MiLB game.
The game was at Sutter Health Park. It was the seventh meeting between the teams this season, with the Comets trailing the season series 3-4 against the River Cats.
Tibbs went hitless in four at-bats and left one runner on base.
The Comets are scheduled to play the River Cats again on Wednesday, July 22, at Sutter Health Park.
James Tibbs — Outfielder — 5′11″ — 201 — Hometown: Atlanta
